title: Vibrant Spiral Swirls
description: An abstract painting on a white canvas featuring multiple overlapping spiral forms in various sizes. The composition uses fluid brushstrokes and splatters in shades of pink, purple, and blue with accents of yellow and a small blue dot.
prompt: Abstract painting on white canvas with multiple overlapping circular spirals and swirls created with fluid expressive brushstrokes. Vibrant composition featuring bright pink, magenta, deep purple, cyan blue and a touch of yellow. Dynamic energy with paint splatters and varying spiral sizes, artistic and colorful modern abstract artwork.
